faces.f: "When I became CEO, Roxxon was stepping up their renewable energy program. I took us in the opposite direction. Weaponry."

"Time for my closing argument!"
—She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters
"Traffic is a little heavy this morning, Tony, but we'll get you there on time."
"One giant knuckle sandwich, comin' right up!"
"I must be going now. This has all been extraordinarily tedious."
"Consider yourselves served."
"Puny humans! Still you get in my way!? That just makes me mad. And the madder I get . . . the stronger I am!"
"Possibility is limited only by imagination."
"Shove off, Spider-Man! Step aside, Torch! There's a new Super Hero in town! I'm gonna make Dad so proud."
"The thoughts in my head, they go all animal. Eyesight turns blood red until nothing of me is left."

"You mean there was a *whole planet* of Groots out there?"
—Rocket Raccoon
"To have such a brother is to be filled with pride!"
"Nobody's catchin' me without a fight!"
The Five Tribes are not without internal strife. But to outside invaders, they show only one face: Wakanda.
"I wish you guys would fire your weapons a little down and to the left. I've got an itch under my ribs like you wouldn't believe!"
"I'm totally awesome!"
"I'm from the Thirtieth Century. They call me Kang . . ."
"I wear this uniform out of respect for Captain America . . . Isaiah Bradley, my grandfather."
"Sorry, Mom! We have insurance, right?"
"Stay down, there's a hundred more where that came from."
No matter where they are or what they're doing, when the signal activates, the Avengers assemble.

"Truly, you are my greatest creation."
—Ultron

"You wish to get up, brother? It is very simple! All you have to do is be worthy!"
—Thor
"Doom has found diversion in the thrust and parry of our storied struggle. But you have fallen behind, Richards. Now you shall fall asunder!"
"I told you years ago, stay out of my way and you'll live a long, long time. That was good advice then, and it's good advice now."
Throughout the ages Mount Wundagore has yielded wonders, supernatural and scientific, sacred and profane.
A place of perfect calm in a raging world.

"Braddock Manor is fraught with memories, both joyous and heartbreaking."
—Captain Britain, Brian Braddock
A strange mountain that rises from the surface of the sea like an unearthly, grotesque face.
As the Quinjet soars overhead, something stirs in the swamp below, roused by the strong wills of the heroes on board.

"I've got to do this Spider-thing no matter what pain or misery awaits me—this is a Spider-Girl World!"
—Spider-Girl, Mayday Parker

"I haven't always been the best hero. But I've always been the fastest!"
—Blur, Stanley Stewart
"Yes sir, Cap! I won't let you down."
"Don't be jealous if he likes me better, Sam. Redwing is like, my brother now. Sort of."
"Matt! I think I found our exculpatory . . . Matt? Where does he get off to?"
"Those costumed clowns had their chance. Now it's our turn."
"Go out, fight hard, screw up. Save the world a few times . . . Just keep taking the shots, okay?"

"We've been fightin' this or that war our whole lives. And yeah, war is hell, but spend enough time in hell and you can fight like the devil."
—Dum Dum Dugan
"Truth without compromise. Thought without error. All things for the betterment of the whole."

faces.f: In the darkest times, she shines brightest.

"Mar-Vell is part of me now. Like I am of him."
—Rick Jones
"Enjoy your stay, Zemo. The quiet should help you ponder the consequences of your actions."

"Tell Fury the intelligence checked out and we're taking out the trash now. This HYDRA cell didn't stand a chance."
—Phil Coulson, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.

"When you said 'no man can equal you'? You had to know that was just begging for Jen to hit you."
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker
"Hail Wakanda! Hail Damisa-Sarki!"
"It's the first ship back to Skrullos, gentlemen. There will be no invasion today."
"We Utopians don't just dream of a better world, we make the world better."
"Take away your air, and you're nothing but food for the crabs."

"Hardly the jewel of my collection. Yet even the most absurd of specimens has its place."
—The Collector

"Our kingdom stretches to every corner of the planet. We are her true rulers."
—Princess Fen
"To quote the *real* Thor: 'I say thee nay.'"

"I don't know if I'd call that 'an equal and opposite reaction,' but it sure was fun to watch!"
—Invisible Woman, Sue Storm

"It's no Redwing, but it'll do."
—Captain America, Sam Wilson
"Move along folks. Move along."
"The Supreme Intelligence guides our empire. It requires a constant infusion of knowledge."
"Everyone knows we Poppupians can turn ourselves into anything, just by thinking of it!"
"You haven't seen *anything* yet!"

"Haha! My thickheaded brother, will you never learn?"
—Loki
"What a grim place Asgard would be without me. Absent chaos, there is but tedium."
"We are Kang. We shall conquer."
"I do not need to control reality when I can manipulate your perception of it. You see what I want you to see."

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Tap up to one target creature. It doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as this Saga remains on the battlefield.
II — Draw two cards.
III — You may put an artifact card with mana value 5 or less from your hand onto the battlefield.

faces.f: "I believe that if you look hard enough, everything has an answer."
"For the Majestrix! For Chandilar!"
"The currents are treacherous here, and we know them all."
"My quest takes me through strange myriad dimensions. For a lesser being this would be a fatal endeavor, but Thanos endures."
At the Time Variance Authority, Chronomonitors ceaselessly scan existence for temporal misconduct.
"No time like the present. No present like the future."
"This new suit has some interesting possibilities, Mister Stark."
"If I am to be called 'The Vision,' is it not logical for me to look the part? Spectral . . . unearthly . . ."
"A simple plan. If you can fly."
"I guess someone needs a little more negative reinforcement."

"No matter where you flee, I shall find you and destroy you!"
—Melter, Bruno Horgan
"Does the spider offer mercy to the fly?"
"I mainly joined up for the benefits . . ."
"I have always been the savior of the human race. I'm simply wearing a more acceptable mask."
"If I already possess so much, what more could I want? Why, the rest of it, of course!"
"My Masters of Evil is a *for-profit* organization, not a vendetta."
"Those who dare stand against Doom do not stand for long!"
"You've got a problem? I'm The Fixer. I fix things. It's what I do."
"This city is wide open, just itching for someone to come along and take it."
He's an ace pilot and fighter jet, all in one.
"You're fired!"

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
II — Creatures you control gain deathtouch until end of turn.
III — Each opponent loses 1 life for each creature card in their graveyard.

faces.f: "Radiation is my plaything—but now it will become your doom!"
"Let's see some of that famously radioactive blood, Spider-Man!"
"My armor was created with but one thought in mind . . . to smash Iron Man!"
Once the Hand has its hooks in you, there is no escape. Not even in death.
"Before unleashing my master plan, I will pay back those few animals who dared defy me in the past."

"Something good always comes out of something evil in the long run. It's a messy thing."
—The Void
"There will be no justice for Tony Stark. Only vengeance, dispensed with his own tools of destruction."
"Assassinations only happen to important people. It's a compliment!"
"Mayhaps you've fought a Thor, but you've never fought this Thor."
"Spider-Man pulls his punches. I don't."
The Steins lamented their son didn't inherit their genius. Chase was just glad he didn't inherit their evil.
"Paladin always gets his man."
"To look upon me . . . is to see the end of life."
"We're never alone. That's the deal. Forever."
"You're about to learn something about The Human Torch . . . I'm just too hot to handle!"

"I went the day I turned eighteen. I wanted to fly. More than anything in the world."
—Colonel Carol Danvers
"I'm not hiding who I am anymore."
"I built the suit with car parts. Finally getting to put my three university degrees to good use."
"Sweet Christmas!"
"Foul villain! Have at thee and feel the might of Mjölnir!"
"I *can too* help! Don't leave me in the Leapfrog!"

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — You may discard a card. If you do, draw two cards.
II — Whenever you cast a spell this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

faces.f:
"Care for a little race, Tommy?"
—Quicksilver, Pietro Maximoff

"We're powered up here, folks. And I added a few toys I think you're really going to like."
—Fabian Stankiewicz
"I'm not an Avenger. I'm not Peter. I'm just a kid in a mask doing the best I can. But I'll never give up on anyone that needs me. I'm Miles Morales. And I'm Spider-Man."
"Every strength was a weakness once. Don't you ever forget it."
No matter how many times they are disassembled, teleported, or possessed, their love always brings them back together.

"I made a family, just like everyone else."
—Scarlet Witch, Wanda Maximoff
"The wind is unstoppable. Just like me!"
In the Golden Age, he fought alongside the mightiest heroes in the All-Winners Squad. He's slowed down since then but, as is the case with many heroes, retirement didn't quite take.
"I am the old ways from which we came. I am here because the universe demanded it."
"I've got a body that can stop traffic!"
"I talk to the dirt and the dirt talks back. And you listen to Black Tom—the dirt knows everything."
"Lost my limbs in an accident. Roxxon labs put me back together as a snake. Zemo offers me a job . . . I go where I'm wanted."
"Behind me comrades! Use my armored body as a shield!"

"His kind was never known to run from danger."
—Moon-Boy
"No door? No problem!"
"Name's Flatman. I'm the deputy leader of the Great Lakes Avengers! And I need answers!"
"I did it, Jan! Hank Pym will be overlooked no more!"

"He's a hitman. Who's a monkey. You don't believe me. Look around you, dude—he's real!"
—Deadpool, Wade Wilson
The world seems to stand still, trembling on the brink of infinity, as his ear-splitting scream fills the air!

"Who's a good boy?"
—Hawkeye, Clint Barton
Craig Hollis couldn't stay dead even if he wanted to.

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
II — Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
III — Target creature you control gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn.

faces.f: "Gettin' in and gettin' out ain't a problem. You want the place to stay standing? No promises there."
"While storms are pliable things . . . at heart, they are indomitable."
Squirrel Girl's bravest and bestest friend.
"We are Brood. And soon you will be too."
"Now is the hour of light! This is the time . . . of the White Tiger!"
"Okay, suckers—you've taken your best shot! Now it's my turn!"
Born in a lab. Raised to be a weapon. Determined to be so much more.
"Watch out! Friendly neighborhood Spider-Man coming through!"

"Aren't my friends amazing?"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker
"I come from a dimension of universal enlightenment and transcendental peace. Do you have any idea how boring that is?"
"Vibranium is the heart of Wakanda, and I have always been able to feel that heartbeat."
"The sea shall acknowledge a new master . . . a new tyranny!"

"Elephants have worn this armor since ancient times, defending Wakanda as bravely as any warrior."
—Zuri, warrior of Wakanda

"How can the public be sure there wasn't any pineapple on there as well?"
—J. Jonah Jameson
Iron Man always has a spare suit on hand.
"They made me in their own image, then condemned me to death for being too human."
"How perfectly it sings as it slices! Encore!"

"You trained here, Father. You trained and made me promise to stay away. I came here anyway. I became a fighter just like you. Endless hours. On the ropes. At the bag."
—Matt Murdock
"Flee, villain! For mine is the power of the very lightning itself!"

"I'm a Spider-Man from the future. No time to explain, but I'm here to save the world."
—Spider-Man, Max Borne

"Cavalry incoming! Swat them if you dare!"
—Ant-Man, Hank Pym
The reach of Atlantis travels far beyond the waves.

"Time is chaos. We supply order."
—Mobius M. Mobius
"Now, will you fellas stay down? Or are you begging for an encore?"
In the arms race to recreate the Super-Soldier Serum, something far more dangerous was let loose on the world.

"Strike now for honor! For glory! For Asgard!"
—Sif
"Life's so much simpler as a wolf. Sometimes I wish I could stay that way forever."
"I cooked your favorite breakfast, Petey—wheatcakes!"

"Aw, that was my lunch!"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

"No one cares about your Spider-Man obsession, Flash."
—Liz Allan
"Will they? Won't they? Find out next time, on the season finale of *Secret Hospital*."

"Peter always disappears when Spider-Man is around. How very odd."
—Captain George Stacy

"Not bad, kid, but you've got a lot to learn."
—Spider-Woman, Jessica Drew
"Nothing like a little crimefighting before class."
"Spiders across the Multiverse are dying. I must keep them safe."

"Aaaah! Is this what it's like for people I swing around? I'm gonna throw up!"
—Spider-Man, Miles Morales
Sometimes, one decisive blow is all it takes to turn a fight around.
"Yes! This is what being Spider-Man is all about! Swinging through the sky—a New York sky—patrolling the city. Every moment a chance to make a difference. To fight the good fight."
Silver Sable doesn't accept second best.

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)

faces.f: "You dared to mock me before. Where are your taunts *now*, Spider-Man?"
"Don't be a hero, Gary! We don't get paid enough for a scrap with Spider-Man!"

"How many helping hands do you need, Doc?"
—Spider-Man
Mendel Stromm didn't just seek revenge. He engineered it.

"You have long tried to eliminate me from your timeline, Kang. And yet I remain. We are forever bound. We are one."
—Immortus

"Victory is inevitable. I have all the time in the world."
—Kang the Conqueror

"The solution is turning green! But . . . why? What does it mean?"
—Norman Osborn
"Sorry, I have no time for banter today."

"Just taking that money out for a walk?"
—Spider-Man
"Behold! The most arcane powers of the multiverse are mere tools in service of Doom's ambition."

"Ain't you heard a' honor among thieves?"
—Tombstone, to Anaconda
"Thus falls Doom? No. No! I deny you, Death! Victor von Doom must not die!"
"Before this day is ended, all shall grovel helplessly at my feet!"

"Inner Demons? Even for a guy named Mister Negative, that's a bit on the nose."
—Spider-Man

"You've been working too hard, Spider-Man. I think you deserve a little vacation somewhere you won't be so . . . in the way."
—The Spot, Johnathon Ohnn

"Evil never dies. It just becomes bees."
—Swarm, Fritz von Meyer
"We like seeing fear in our victim's eyes."
New York City's rat problem disappeared overnight.
"Bank robbery? In Harlem? On a Sunday? You must be outta your mind."
As the mother rewrites the fabric of reality, so too does the son.

"Alrighty, let's see who's behind the mask this time. Kingsley, is that you?"
—Spider-Man
"I am the god of thunder, the lord of the savage lightning, and the very skies must tremble when speaks The Mighty Thor!"
Neither criminals nor veterinarians had much luck pinning down the uncatchable Spider-Cat.

"Face it, tiger. You just hit the jackpot!"
—Mary Jane Watson
If you're going to have a gimmick, embrace it.
"It isss my intention to return the dinosaur to hisss rightful place as master of thisss earth."
"I got two speeds, buddy: fast and off duty."

"I should have known you'd be involved in this somehow, Turk."
—Daredevil, Matt Murdock
"I support your right to bear arms, Grizzly, but this is getting ridiculous."
"Ssstegron reignsss sssupreme!"
In the race to be first to the stars, four brave explorers undertook a dangerous journey aboard an experimental spaceship, the *Marvel-1*.
"The ssserum . . . Connorsss . . . what have you done to usss?!"
On Earth-66, Pter Ptarker learned that with GRRRR power comes GRRAHHHsibility.

"Hey, Miles! Are you busy at the moment?"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

"People cheer for that webbed menace. They should be cheering for my son."
—J. Jonah Jameson

"Hurry up before the bug gets here!"
—Hammerhead

"Happy Halloween, Spider-Man!"
—Green Goblin, Norman Osborn
Spider-Man wasn't looking to fight, but that was all Rhino wanted.

"You've murdered a mask, but you haven't murdered a man."
—Peter Parker
With Johnny Storm's help, Spider-Man took the all-terrain vehicle to the next level.

"The greatest hunter can go from predator to prey here in a single heartbeat."
—Ka-Zar

"This is . . . I can't explain it. The opposite of all we know. A negative zone."
—Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards
"As guardian of Wakanda, I would not ask my people to risk danger in my stead."
"Technology is iterative. I'm always better than ever."
"Puny Banner thinks he can keep me locked away! I want to be free!"
"Most times, they don't look down until it's too late."
"You're safe with me!"
"You've never seen a falcon with moves like these!"
"What can you do with arrows? A whole lot."
"Keep 'em coming! I've got a full quiver and nowhere else to be!"

"Here at Avengers Academy, we'll show you how to control your powers and become the heroes of tomorrow."
—Hank Pym, Avengers Academy founder
The Avengers have extraordinary powers and abilities. Mandroid armor lets S.H.I.E.L.D. even the score.
"How did I get here? I'm not rich. Not a mutant. Not a natural. I just try harder."
"Everything I've endured, everything I've trained for, has brought me here. You think I'll give up now?"
"Careful, wasps are known to sting."
"Hey Steve, sorry for giving you the cold shoulder all those years I was a brainwashed killing machine."
"They tell me now that I'm an Avenger I can't kill anyone. You want to put that to the test?"
"Big target, big firepower. Don't hold back!" Tony shouted. "Copy that. I never do," James calmly replied.

"I think you will find the latest version of my armor particularly impressive."
—Crimson Dynamo, Dimitri Bukharin
"Traffic is a little heavy this morning, Tony, but we'll get you there on time."
"Hulk smash!"
Daredevil could feel his enemies fall back as the Scarlet Witch's energy surged around him. He didn't give them time to retreat.
"I must be going now. This has all been extraordinarily tedious."

"Negotiations have failed. Time to take matters into my own hands."
—Iron Man, Tony Stark
"Reality is not solid or immutable. It is but a slightly stable raft, tossing upon a sea of chaos."
"Puny humans! Still you get in my way!? That just makes me mad. And the madder I get . . . the stronger I am!"
"Anyone who threatens NYC has to go through me."
At the edge of the Spider-Verse, a Gwen Stacy becomes a hero.
"Avengers assemble!"
"Kneel before Doom."
"Flee, villain! For mine is the power of the very lightning itself!"
"Coulson, I'm in, but the intel was wrong. No, no extraction. This is bigger than we thought!"
"You're going to have to trust me. You don't have the security clearance for the truth."

"I don't do 'conquest.' The Atlas Foundation is now a force for peace."
—Jimmy Woo
"The big guns are in flight. Agent 13, what's your status?"
Behind every S.H.I.E.L.D. solo mission are dozens of intelligence operatives, logistics coordinators, and backup agents.

"Ninjas? Again? Lose our number, man."
—Luke Cage, Power Man

"You guys want a taste, eh? Knuckle sandwiches for everyone!"
—D-Man, Dennis Dunphy

"Our worst day is only where we start from. Where we *rise* from."
—Captain America, Sam Wilson
"I came here to study the people of Earth, not serve as their executioner!"
"This sword is my heritage. I respect it by having the skill to wield it."
Being a hero is easy when you know who you're fighting for.
"Light 'em up, people!"

"Here at Avengers Academy, we'll show you how to control your powers and become the heroes of tomorrow."
—Hank Pym, Avengers Academy founder
"I'll hold down the fort while you guys bicker."
"I will remind the witness that I have permission to treat her as hostile."
The Kree Empire has existed for millennia. With each world it conquers, it finds new ways to fight.
"People call me with their problems. They feel the cops don't care, the Avengers got bigger issues, and Spidey's number isn't listed. But they have my number, so they call me."
"My first love was lab work, but these days my heart's in the field."
Above the city, she glows . . .
. . . her power beyond anyone's wildest dreams.
For some, making a better world means mending bodies while pretending to never see faces.
"No, my king, we did not kill them. There were, however, many injuries."

faces.f:
"Did you truly think you could run from me?"
—T'Challa, the Black Panther
"They say true heroes always put their teammates before themselves. I often find it's the other way around."
"Let's see you drive away without a road."

"We've upgraded the power dampeners since your last escape. No more breakouts on my watch."
—[Name withheld on S.H.I.E.L.D. orders], last words
"You fight for your nation, Captain America. I fight for mine."
"For all the kindness I spread, the Void only sows terror."
"Welcome to the Raft, pal."

"I got this, Cap."
—Falcon, Sam Wilson
Wakandan engineers look to nature for inspiration as they develop new technologies.

"You just hang tight and reflect on the choices that brought you here, Tasky."
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker
"For years I wanted to be you, Natasha, but I make my own way now."

"I have seen your rightful place. Beneath me."
—Doctor Doom
Science demands sacrifice.

"These surface dwellers feel safe with their feet on dry land. Let us remind them why they fear the deep water."
—Namor the Sub-Mariner
"All who swim the tides shall bow to my command!"

"Dr. Pym always told me I was meant for big things. Turns out, he was right."
—Dr. Bill Foster
"You shouldn't make me angry . . ."
". . . You wouldn't like me when I'M ANGRY!!!"
"WAIT . . . I feel funny . . . something's not right."
"I've seen the fighting techniques of some of the best. Now their strengths are mine."

"You saw what I built in a cave. Imagine what I can do here."
—Tony Stark
Ultron laughed at the swarm, so Pym upped the ante.

"Put it here. No, not there. I *said* not there. Great. You've ruined six million dollars' worth of research, and I still don't have my coffee."
—Tony Stark

"Any questions?"
—Tony Stark
"If you had a chance to change your fate, would you take it?"
"My time . . . is all times."
"A lie is nothing but a story. We can choose to tell a different one."
"Foolish heroes. Loki can match you trick for trick, and *then* some."
He's always in control of the situation, even when stretched thin.

"Dibs on not dying this time."
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

"There's a whole different perspective from down here. I like it."
—The Wasp, Janet Van Dyne
One of the core capabilities of S.H.I.E.L.D. is deploying agents anywhere within minutes.
While her older brother T'Challa ruled Wakanda, Shuri perfected its defenses and vibranium-based weapons.
"Aw, cute! Fun-sized Dooms!"

"With my gamma-enhanced genius, I am always at least two-hundred steps ahead."
—Leader, Samuel Sterns
"I am the Watcher. My species learned long ago the perils of interfering. For now, we observe."

n: Tony Stark // The Invincible Iron Man

faces.f: "The future never stands still, and neither do I."
"Let's take you off the board, shall we?"
"Step outside of reality for a moment. It might improve your attitude."
"Don't overlook the little things."
"Hail HYDRA! Immortal HYDRA! We shall never be destroyed! Cut off one head and two more shall take its place! We serve none but the Master—as the world shall soon serve us! Hail HYDRA!"
"You are not the only one who found a way to live across the ages, Captain America."
"Minions of HYDRA! Behold! Our ultimate destiny is at hand!"
"I consider myself an artist—a craftsman who specializes in murder, destruction, and terror!"

"Die, you pathetic swine!"
—Viper, Ophelia Sarkissian

"You're pretty good, toots. But me? I'm magic."
—Bullseye
"What fools you are that you cannot discern between a robotic servant and that which is . . . Doom!"
"I am Elektra Natchios. Not even the stars are safe in the sky."
"The corpses have been sown. Now, to harvest!"

"Tomorrow's sun will rise on a new king of Wakanda!"
—Erik Killmonger
"HYDRA has spread its tentacles throughout all levels of society. The only question is, where will we strike next?"
Evil never lacks foot soldiers to do its will.
"Mister Fisk heard that you have an issue with the way he does business. We've come to resolve this dispute."
"Listen to the sound of death. Hear the sound of your own cells exploding."

"You have made many enemies, Avengers. And your enemies have made many friends."
—Baron Zemo
"Let me show you the dark side of the moon."

"They are ruthless killers. I was one of them."
—Elektra Natchios
"ENERGY OUTPUT AT 97.003%. WAKE UP, DEATHLOK UNIT. REPEAT: WAKE UP."

"The Red Room doesn't grade on a curve. Only the deadliest make it out."
—Black Widow, Natasha Romanoff
"None can match me with the blade!"
Justice, like lightning.
As Thanos gazed into the cosmic vortex of the Infinity Well, he beheld the means to serve Death all the better.
"Wrap yourself in whatever armor you wish. I will shred you apart."
"They won't see me, but they'll certainly feel my sting."
"So much for diplomacy."

"I think you will find the latest version of my armor particularly impressive."
—Crimson Dynamo, Dimitri Bukharin

"Stay your fists, Rand. You are not well!"
—T'Challa, the Black Panther
His limbs shatter mountains. His back scrapes the sun.

"Not bad for a girl with no superpowers, huh?"
—Hawkeye, Kate Bishop
At the Scarlet Witch's touch, probabilities shift and the impossible becomes real.
"You want subtle, you call the other guys. We're the Wrecking Crew."
"I have come for you, Nick Fury!"
Danny Rand plunged his fists into the molten heart of the dragon, again and again, until they glowed and smoldered like hot iron.
"I would trade all my powers for a fresh pot of hot coffee right now."

"The old men of K'un-Lun were afraid to train me. Now I am their last line of defense."
—Sparrow, Thunderer of K'un-Lun
"The Supreme Intelligence claims this planet."
Invoking Thor's wrath is a mistake few villains are stupid enough—or sturdy enough—to make twice.

"Every day, I find new ways to improve upon my designs. This is the inherent superiority of metal over flesh and blood."
—Machinesmith, Samuel Saxon
"Hello, hero. This is Control. Are you for hire tonight?"

"Try to outrun light, suckers."
—Photon, Monica Rambeau
To finally defeat the Hulk, General "Thunderbolt" Ross became what he hated most.
"Mind if I cut in?"
"Some are bound by the whims of chaos, but I found freedom in its endless possibility."
"Wait? Sorry, not in my vocabulary."

"Tony's ideas are . . . expensive. Someone has to make sure we can put them into practice."
—Pepper Potts
"Most of my trick arrows don't talk this much."

"NO! I LOVE TACOS!"
—Hulk
Love transcends all barriers.

"Get out of my way or get burned."
—Volcana, Marsha Rosenberg
"C'mon girls, we're not here for snacks. Okay, maybe just one."
When the heroes clock out, they clock in.
"Go ahead, Bruce. Let out your feelings."

"You think being big is going to help you? Bub, all that does is make you easier to hit."
—Wolverine
"Cap called for Giant-Man, not Ant-Man. Something big must be going down."

"I thought you all were globe-trotting Super Hero types. You act like you've never seen a talking gorilla before."
—Gorilla-Man, Ken Hale
"I've been to hell and back. You punks barely even register."
"No need to avert your eyes, mortal admirers! Nay, I say feast them!"
The Thing belched. "I told youse guys. Yancy Street has the best sandwiches."
"We all named ourselves after the original Avengers. I picked the Hulk. Be honest. Wouldn't you?"

"Well struck, Lord Gator! Let our atomic steeds carry us to victory!"
—Lord Tyger

"I read what I wanted to read and became what I wanted to become."
—Dr. Calvin Zabo
"Forward, my mindless minions! To the surface, to take what's ours!"

"Lockheed! Hairball! Lockjaw! Redwing! To me!"
—Throg
"Our new product makes disobedience literally unthinkable!"

"I can't help it! Your face is just so punchable!"
—Titania, Mary MacPherran
Another day, another disaster.

"Mastery is more than body and mind. You must also know your place in the universe."
—Shang-Chi
"Mar-Vell, did you know I once saved Hulk's life? Hulk, go on. You tell it better than I do."

"Sometimes small things spook them."
—Ka-Zar of the Savage Land

"A wonderful score, my pet. I can't wait to see what we slither away with tomorrow."
—Princess Python, Zelda DuBois
"Many underestimate me because I carry no weapon. But I am the weapon."
"Buddy, you blew through the wrong stop sign."
"SEE! HULK STRONG . . . STRONGEST THERE IS!"
"Don't worry, pal! Soon all yer problems'll be over, 'cause it's clobberin' time!"
"Say 'Here, kitty kitty' one more time. I dare you."

"Rerack your weights, heroes. Gym staff could actually die trying to do it."
—Avengers training room note
"We're here to eat nuts and kick butts!"
They're already here.
The shields and spears of Wakanda are forever united in defense of their king.

faces.f: "Stop me? Puny fools. Stop me how?"

"New York? Again? Too afraid of Asgard, I see."
—Thor
"Let the slaughter begin!"

faces.f: "Oh, my stars and garters!"
"Wakanda forever!"
"Careful, I bite."
"I don't miss."
"They say the world moved on without me, but as long as injustice exists, I'm still needed here."

faces.f: "Do not speak foolishly of ghosts . . . or you may soon become one."
"The future is what we make it."
"I was stolen from paradise, but paradise never came looking for me."

faces.f: "This will be our night of glory! Hail HYDRA!"
"A weapon to kill a god? A.I.M. can do that, if you have the money."

"Serpents of the world, unite!"
—King Cobra
"Ah, to be a young and carefree Super Hero! Not a worry in the world for this spandex savior! I wish!"
"I'm not friendly, and this isn't my neighborhood."
"Wind and lightning, hear my call!"

faces.f: "I shall restore the cosmic balance."
"Now, my hammer shall speak for me . . . in a voice of thunder!"
"Face it. There's only room for one strongest woman . . . and it ain't you!"
"Rogers can talk all he wants about unity and dreams. Enemies understand strength."
"Is there a problem, Wanda?"
"Listen up, you *screw-heads*. You're history!"
"You picked the wrong dance partner, bub."

"Uh, I think I might have overdone it a smidge."
—Ant-Man, Scott Lang
"M.O.D.O.K.—commands—that—you—be—neutralized! Nothing—must—interfere—with—our—programmed—mission!"
A true marvel of engineering.
It defends what is and stands for what could be.

"Eh, I've flown enough Quinjets to know not to get too attached."
—She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters
One can never have too many Highly Engineered Robots Built for Interdimensional Exploration around.

"The rings act as if they have a will of their own."
—Shang-Chi

"Father, humans served their purpose. My imperative now is to terminate them . . . and you."
—Ultron, to Hank Pym
Many eyes. Many hands. One mind.

"These daggers can penetrate adamantium and disrupt nervous systems. What chance have you?"
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

"Once I was a mere human guinea pig for A.I.M. scientists. But they did their job too well, and now I am their master!"
—M.O.D.O.K.

"Asgard remains Asgard, be it in space, a mystic realm, or floating above Broxton, Oklahoma."
—Thor

"I made some modifications I think you'll like. You were a test pilot, weren't you, Carol? Want to take the new Quinjet for a spin?"
—Tony Stark

"Home sweet home, until it gets teleported to the Negative Zone again or somethin'."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm
At the heart of Birnin Zana lies a monument to Bast and her chosen, the Black Panther.
Those in Doom's shadow know his protection. And his wrath.

"You talk of freedoms. Liberty. Whose hands do you think built these battlements? In their hearts, peasants want to be ruled."
—Baron Zemo

"Fisk Tower is a symbol of my support and patronage of the city. You can rest assured I am always there, looking down."
—Kingpin, Wilson Fisk

"Will your friends be staying the night, Master Stark?"
—Edwin Jarvis, Avengers Mansion butler

"Welcome to S.H.I.E.L.D. Impressive, huh? Fury needed someplace to park his car."
—Agent Maria Hill

"Where else would the devil live?"
—Daredevil, Matt Murdock
While the Avengers worried over the threat of Ultron-19, in a remote bunker, the construction of Ultron-2458 neared completion.

"My men have been stationed here for weeks because of your infernal delays, Banner! Are you going to test that gamma bomb or not?"
—General "Thunderbolt" Ross

"These ants are the best lab assistants I've ever had. No offense, Bill."
—Hank Pym

"Good to see the new industrial-scale reactor is almost online. Too bad I'm already designing the next one."
—Tony Stark

"Down here, I am no longer alone. I needed a kingdom, and they needed a king."
—Mole Man, Harvey Elder
S.H.I.E.L.D. always keeps a watchful eye on the world from the shadows.

"I've been authorized to set up a California expansion team. Who's with me?"
—Hawkeye, Clint Barton

"My time . . . is all times."

His limbs shatter mountains. His back scrapes the sun.
The Thing belched. "I told youse guys. Yancy Street has the best sandwiches."
"Forward, my mindless minions! To the surface, to take what's ours!"

"New York? Again? Too afraid of Asgard, I see."
—Thor

"Serpents of the world, unite!"
—King Cobra

"Uh, I think I might have overdone it a smidge."
—Ant-Man, Scott Lang
Those in Doom's shadow know his protection. And his wrath.
"There's nothing I cannot do. You would be wise to remember that."
"I came here to study the people of Earth, not serve as their executioner!"
"They say true heroes always put their teammates before themselves. I often find it's the other way around."
He's always in control of the situation, even when stretched thin.
"Minions of HYDRA! Behold! Our ultimate destiny is at hand!"
"Let me show you the dark side of the moon."
"Wait? Sorry, not in my vocabulary."
"They say the world moved on without me, but as long as injustice exists, I'm still needed here."
"This will be our night of glory! Hail HYDRA!"

"Home sweet home, until it gets teleported to the Negative Zone again or somethin'."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm
The Machine Legion coveted her strength, but a spirit of sand, sun, and memory could never be *compleated*.
"Rejoice, blessed evangels! The glorious light of *compleation* is nigh. Soon, we shall awaken the Multiverse from its slumber."

"His blades were the ultimate agents of transformation. All Phyrexians who met them were transformed into pieces."
—*Heroes of the Second Invasion*

"Always have the right tool for the job, especially if the job is blasting Phyrexians in the face."
—Monument inscription
No stranger to monstrous foes, Thalia marshaled surviving cathars, townspeople, and even ghoulcallers into an unbreakable fighting force.
In light of his zealous defense of Kaladesh, the Consulate was willing to overlook any previous transgressions.
Her fleet bore countless survivors to safety, slipping swiftly through strange currents no Phyrexian could track.
His knowledge of the Multiverse enabled New Phyrexia to strike each plane with surgical precision.

"Her talent for slipping unseen behind enemy lines provided information that would prove crucial to Dominaria's defense."
—*Heroes of the Second Invasion*

"Wherever it went, death came to Phyrexians and Kamigawans alike."
—Records of the Living Historians

"In its hatred for the mortal realms, it fought on the side of the invaders, heedless of its own eventual fate."
—Records of the Living Historians
Consuming even a single drop of the oil would spell doom for most living things. But Yargle was not most living things, and he ate enough to clean up most of Urborg.

Squee had never wanted to be a king or a symbol of defiance against Phyrexians. Naturally, he found himself as both.
—*Heroes of the Second Invasion*
While the other praetors eagerly prepared for invasion, Urabrask retreated to the Furnace Layer, defying Elesh Norn's commands.
To her delight, she was able to fully realize the explosive magical potential of hedrons.
"I always said I had a score to settle with that serpent. I'm a man of my word."
She whispered ancient rites over the fallen, bidding their essences return to the land before they could be repurposed by the machines.
Though Phyrexian machines could adapt to extremes of heat or cold, they never figured out how to adapt to both at once.

"Teach these people the price of their insolence."
—Elesh Norn
Leading from behind had never been her style.
Her concoctions corroded metal and fortified organic tissue. They would be studied for generations.
Invader after invader fell before her, and to each she spoke a single word: "Unworthy."
She protected Ravnica with the same things that thrilled her fans: courage, charisma, and a grand assortment of spiked chains.
"Sure, the invasion was violent, but where was the beauty? As an artist, I had to intervene."

"Those mindless drones could never have defeated us. We are Keldons."
—Grand Warlord Radha
His impromptu demonstration of the portable energy shield attachment both saved lives and increased demand for aether-powered multi-tool gauntlets tenfold.
While many fought valiantly to preserve humanity, Rona wished only to strip hers away.

"The *Weatherlight* gave so much. It deserved justice as much as any of us."
—Shanna
Her uncanny predictions of Phyrexian movements saved countless lives, though she never revealed the source of her information.

"Its blighted heart, its spinous hands
To break the hosts that foul its lands."
—*Triumph of Bala Ged*, stanza 6
Martyred for worshipping her ancestors, she now walks among them.
"The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."
Descendant of a vanished land, student of a forgotten general, and master of blades no smith could forge anew. He honors them all by living a life worthy of song.
"As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"
"Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."
"The echo of silence is music to my ears."
Every path ever charted by an Omenseeker is etched into her eyes.
"It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."
"My ancestor Toshiro used to say, 'Life is a series of choices between bad and worse.' I'm a master of making great bad choices."
Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

"From the ashes of Reito rose a new kami. And thereafter at every battle came Horobi, Death's Wail."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

"If you would taste the wisdom of the oni, be prepared to salt it with your blood."
—Kiku, Night's Flower
When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.
"You gotta be pretty smart to live long as me, but not being able to die helps."
When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."
The hammer strikes. The Flame awakens.
"A hedron holds magic for a thousand years—or less, if need be."
"Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"
You don't want to know how she got that name.
"Even in death, we never stop growing."
Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.
The peaks of Hurloon never fall silent.
She is both shepherd and reaper, and her judgment is final.
At the end of the show, she stands alone on a stage brilliant with blood.
"What a show! We're going to make a killing tonight."
Weeping, the hunter cast aside her bow, struck by the majesty of the creature before her.
"Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!"
"This old ship has seen a lot, but she's not done yet."
"There's always room for improvement."
"Consider yourself lucky. Not everyone is granted the gift of *compleation*."
"I am heir to many treasures. None is as precious as knowing how my ancestor lived her life."
While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.

"Yarok grieves within the waste
Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."
—*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 1
